value.title: Roadmaps become workstreams
value.summary: Ruling C29: rename roadmaps forward to workstreams (folder, schema pij/workstream, skill, templates v2, PRD rows), add nesting (part_of), lanes and cross-file ordering, define 'a pij stream is one lane of a workstream', and make coverage a harness checks sensor.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Lands after the open batch (#129 to #137, plus #135's directory edit). Source: governance community/workstreams-audit-2026-11-06.md (Summary and Appendix E) and RULINGS.md C29. Rename forward as C26 did: history, plans 190 to 195, retros, migrations (0031/0032 comments are checksummed), outputs and memory are not rewritten. Step ids (steps, sNN) stay. No store or CLI rename for pij streams. Docs-system writes the schema, docs and skill wording; one coder does the sensor, the claims alias cleanup and any code that reads the folder. Amended 2026-11-08 (pm-001): two phases and two PRs (docs content by docs-system, then rename, code and sensor by a coder), because the rename must ship with the code that reads the folder; templates are v3 because #136 shipped v2 for quoting.

sections.name: goals
value: Ruling C29: rename roadmaps forward to workstreams (folder, schema pij/workstream, skill, templates v2, PRD rows), add nesting (part_of), lanes and cross-file ordering, define 'a pij stream is one lane of a workstream', and make coverage a harness checks sensor.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

value.claim: Schema. `.dd/schemas/pij/workstream` validates a workstream doc: steps keep id, state, plan, delivers, needs (roles) and depends_on (may cross files); a step may be `part_of` another workstream's step (cross-file link), and an umbrella step can't be complete while a child isn't; `lanes` lists 0..n lanes (branch, worktree, optional pij stream id; PRs come from deliveries, not stored). pij/roadmap stays for history, marked superseded.
value.receipt: assets/evidence/phase-1.md (schema); assets/evidence/phase-2.md#ac6-the-coverage-sensor (the umbrella roll-up, which ddocs can't express)

value.claim: Rename. docs/project/roadmaps/001-pij-community moves to docs/project/workstreams/001-pij-community (git mv, schema id pij/workstream, a changelog line citing C29); docs/project/README.md and every live reference follow; s16 'workstreams' is added to it and goes complete in this PR. pij claim's roadmap alias keeps scanning both folders; `pij delivered` resolves workstream addresses (both from #131).

Skill. skills/pij references roadmap.md becomes workstream.md: shape, split, merge, nest, lanes, coverage; it defines workstream and pij stream so they never overlap ('a pij stream is one lane of a workstream'), says that in a PEC project workstream docs govern ordering over prime-flow items, and notes sNN step ids versus sNNN stream branches. The protocol gets the lane line. The prompting follows C18, C26 and C28 (shaped, split, merged and nested as the work demands).

PRD and coverage fixes. PRD 001 amends req-04, 18, 20, 21, 23, 24 and 27 to workstream wording and adds rows for nesting and lanes and for coverage. req-26 and req-27 gain a delivering step; PRD 002's 14 rows get a blueprint and a workstream (or explicit links into existing ones), so nothing is orphaned.
value.receipt: assets/evidence/phase-1.md#tk-0003-prd (PRD wording and rows); assets/evidence/ac4-coverage.md (req-26 step, PRD 002 blueprint and workstream, exemptions removed)

value.claim: Templates v3. pm, coder, pa, prime, reviewer and security templates ship v3 with workstream wording (v1 and v2 unchanged, never edited; #136 shipped v2 of these six for shell quoting, so the rename is v3). `pij directory templates --show <name>@v2` shows them; the 10 optional templates from #136 already use workstream.

Coverage sensor. `harness checks` gains a coverage stage (in .harness/extensions/checks/ and `just self-check`): every PRD requirement is delivered by some workstream step and every blueprint component is built by some step; failures name the row. It runs once per check, with no loop or poll.

Governance re-point (#135 merged: pij directory edit is live). The 8 live governance role prompts that cite the roadmap path are re-pointed with `pij directory edit` (docs-system runs it; the writer commits).

value.question: Prefix for new workstream step ids: keep sNN everywhere, or use w-prefixed ids in new docs only (audit Appendix E)? Default: keep sNN, and document the sNNN branch distinction.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
